step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows Amazon Global Accelerator routing traffic to EC2 bidder instances, which query an Aerospike database on EC2. Additional components drawn without line connections include ALB, a second EC2 icon, and Amazon S3. The diagram flow starts at Global Accelerator and connects through EC2 to the Database.

graph.name: The Trade Desk: Global Low-Latency Ad Bidding Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture leverages Amazon Global Accelerator to route high-volume traffic to low-latency .NET bidder EC2 instances backed by Aerospike on EC2.
